/**
   * Whether the client is currently running.
   *
   * This will be false if `initialize()` hasn't been called yet, or if
   * `shutdown()` has been called.
   *
   * The client is considered running if it's either performing operations, or
   * waiting for new ones.
   */
  readonly attribute boolean running;

  /**
   * Whether the client is not currently processing any operation and is fully
   * waiting for one to be triggered.
   *
   * If `running` is `false`, then `idle` will also be `false`.
   */
  readonly attribute boolean idle;
